title: Nǐ Hǎo — Hello, Character by Character
label: ch:zh-nihao
canDo: I can greet someone in Mandarin and answer when greeted, reading both characters unaided and saying the greeting with the tone a speaker actually uses rather than the one the dictionary prints.

payoff.summary: A two-line meeting in which both voices say the same word — read from the characters alone, with the first third tone raised by sandhi.
